versions.changelog:
Initial release of Java 编码指南 (java-coding-guide-pro):

- Provides clear, opinionated Java coding standards covering JDK 8–25+ (focus on LTS versions).
- Outlines a detection/adaptation step for existing project tech stack and JDK version.
- Prioritizes best practices and established libraries across common areas: null checks, collections, dates, IO, HTTP, JSON, concurrency, Bean mapping, crypto, exception handling, money calculations, and modern Java features.
- Includes S/A level rules table for code review/generation, with high-risk scenarios (S) and guidance-oriented suggestions (A).
- Enforces "follow existing stack," single recommendation per scenario, and strict JDK feature gating.
- Integrates C-CHECK prompts for introducing libraries only in high-risk areas when missing from the current stack.
